message.content: The service should stop the drone from trying to charge at a pad that doesn’t match its connector. Since the connectors aren’t interchangeable, the system needs to know which drone is going to which pad and make sure they’re compatible. If it sends a drone to the wrong pad, it could just sit there without charging—or worse, get damaged trying. I don’t know how the system checks this, but it has to prevent that mismatch.
